description: "FastCode: Accelerating and Streamlining Your Code Understanding"

summary.one_liner: FastCode is a Python framework for token-efficient question answering over large code repositories, offered as a web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server.
summary.what_it_does: It indexes a codebase by parsing files, classes, functions, and documentation with AST-based parsing across 8+ languages, then builds a hybrid index that combines semantic embeddings with BM25 keyword search. It also builds three graphs (call, dependency, and inheritance) to navigate code structurally, following connections up to two steps away. Queries run a two-stage search and load only the relevant code rather than whole files, with budget-aware logic that decides what context to gather. It supports single and multi-repository questions, multi-turn sessions, and a Docker-based Feishu (Lark) bot integration via Nanobot. The README's performance and cost comparisons against Cursor and Claude Code are the project's own claims and were not independently verified here.
use_cases: ask natural-language questions about an unfamiliar codebase
find where a feature or logic is implemented
impact analysis before changing a data model
give an AI coding assistant repo-level context via MCP
query code from a chat bot in Feishu/Lark
how_to_run: cp env.example .env   # then set OPENAI_API_KEY, MODEL, BASE_URL
notable: Three-graph structural model (call, dependency, inheritance) for navigating code beyond text search
Hybrid retrieval combining embeddings and BM25 keyword search
MCP server usable from Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf, with stdio or SSE transport
Web UI, CLI, and REST API share the same features
Local model support via Ollama-style OpenAI-compatible endpoints
caveats: Requires an LLM API key or a locally served model; the README shows OpenAI, OpenRouter, and Ollama configurations
Speed and cost comparisons against Cursor and Claude Code are self-reported benchmarks
The Feishu/Nanobot integration needs Docker and a Feishu app with configured permissions and event subscriptions
